name: Örnsteinn
title: The Master Mason
abilityWindow: When a player would resolve an exploration card
abilityText: You may exhaust this card. If you do, that player may discard that card and place 1 structure on a planet they control in the active system.

name: Aðalsteinn
title: The Unbroken
abilityWindow: When 1 or more of your PDS units use their SPACE CANNON ability
abilityText: For each hit produced in excess of that player's units in that system, gain 1 commodity.
unlockCondition: Have 3 or more structures in any 1 system.

name: Þorsteinn
title: Of the Deep Frost
abilityText: Place this card next to the game board. Until the end of this game round, when a player's ships move into the active system, you may use the SPACE CANNON ability of each of your units on the game board against those ships. At the end of this game round, purge this card.

name: Olistef Olafsson
title: Guide Raven
abilityWindow: At the end of a player's tactical action
abilityText: You may exhaust this card. If you do, that player may remove 1 of their ships in the active system and place it in an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships.

name: Adalgust Fjarsynni
title: The Wayfinder
abilityText: You may move your retreating ships up to 2 systems away.
unlockCondition: Have a combined resource and influence value on Blot of at least 3.

name: Aleksander Ravnsbarn
title: Dark Void Seer
abilityText: Return all control tokens on Blot to their owners' reinforcements. For each of another player's control tokens returned this way, choose 1 of that player's units that is not a flagship or war sun and destroy it. For each of your control tokens returned this way, gain either 1 command token or 2 trade goods. Then, purge this card.

name: The Vigorous Sapling
title: The Vigorous Sapling
abilityWindow: At the end of a player's tactical action
abilityText: You may exhaust this card. If you do, that player places 1 Root token on a planet in the active system and may produce up to a number of units in that system equal to the number of traits that planet has.

name: The Hidden Branches
title: The Hidden Branches
abilityWindow: At the start of the status phase
abilityText: Choose 1 planet trait. Gain 1 commodity for every 2 planets with that trait that you control.
unlockCondition: Control at least 1 Cultural, 1 Industrial, and 1 Hazardous planet.

name: The Roused Grove
title: The Roused Grove
abilityText: Return any number of your command tokens from systems that contain 1 or more of your Root tokens to your reinforcements. Then, ready any number of planets that contain Root tokens and place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on planets you control that contain a Root token. Then, purge this card.

name: Sigrun
title: The Weaver
abilityWindow: When a player's unit is destroyed
abilityText: You may exhaust this card to HALLOW another of that player's units in the destroyed unit's system.

name: Brunhilde
title: The Valiant Shield
abilityText: Each of your damaged units roll an additional die during combat.
unlockCondition: Have 4 HALLOWED units on the game board.

name: Skuld
title: The Allmother's Herald
abilityText: You may produce up to 3 ships and 4 ground forces total in systems containing your units with production and you may HALLOW up to 3 of your units on the game board. Then, purge this card.
